items.name: Up Quark
items.codex: One of two quark types that make up protons and neutrons. Carries a +2/3 electric charge.

items.name: Down Quark
items.codex: One of two quark types that make up protons and neutrons. Carries a -1/3 electric charge.

items.name: Electron
items.codex: A fundamental particle with a negative charge. Orbits the nucleus of atoms and determines chemical bonding behavior.

items.name: Proton
items.codex: A baryon made of 2 up quarks and 1 down quark. Charge +1. Defines the element.

items.name: Neutron
items.codex: A baryon made of 1 up quark and 2 down quarks. Electrically neutral. Determines the isotope.

items.name: Hydrogen
items.codex: The simplest atom — one proton orbited by one electron. Most abundant element in the universe.

items.name: Helium-4
items.codex: Two protons, two neutrons, two electrons. The primary product of stellar nucleosynthesis.
